approved_phrases: Built for the AURA MUSIC community
notes.scope: The sweep covers the shipped tree. The replica/ planning and reference-evidence folder is intentionally excluded by the sweep tool.
notes.why_feature_names_are_not_in_avoid: The sweep matches identifiers, file names and comments as well as user-facing text. Legacy compact terms such as EchoMusic, echomusic, Echo Music folder paths, chomusic fragments inside echomusic identifiers, and iad1tya are documented exceptions; user-facing values were checked separately with targeted scans and fixed.
notes.exception_policy: Those terms remain only inside preserved GPLv3/Apache/third-party notices, build paths, package, module, resource-id, storage-key, widget-intent, ProGuard and JNI identifiers. Renaming them would break upgrades, widgets, shortcuts, local data and builds. They are inventoried in replica/brand.md.
